sloka: यन्मया वार्यमाणस्त्वं नावगच्छसि दुर्मते ।पश्चादस्य फलं प्राप्य ज्ञास्यसे निरयं गतः ।। ७.१५.१८ ॥
transliteration: yanmayā vāryamāṇastvaṁ nāvagacchasi durmate ।paścādasya phalaṁ prāpya jñāsyase nirayaṁ gataḥ ।। 7.15.18 ॥

translations.english: O evil-minded one, because you do not understand even when restrained by me, you will realize the consequence of this after having gone to hell.
